tei:div.tei:p: This is the full invocation offered by Rabbi Abba Hillel Silver at the Republican National Convention in Chicago, Illinois, on 9 July 1952, as reported in an otherwise unidentified newspaper clipping titled, “Prayer for Guidance: Rabbi Silver Asks Blessing on Throng.” An abridged form of this prayer was published in the Jewish Independent, on Friday 11 July 1952. The clipping is preserved in the records of Abba Hillel Silver at the American Jewish Archives. Many thanks to Howard Mortman for informing us of this prayer.
